rtc.description: What this entity is saying out loud this moment: the Realtime session it publishes from, the tracks a listener asks for, and whether it is muted or talking. Relayed and kept by nobody, so it goes with the tab that wrote it, and a listener stops hearing it then.

session.description: the Realtime session the tracks are published from

tracks.description: the names of the tracks it publishes, each asked for as a remote track of the session

talking.description: its microphone hears a voice this moment

sfu.description: A Realtime session this app's door opened, while its lease holds: the wake beside it is when the lease ends, and the session's tracks close when it does.

session.description: the session's id at Cloudflare Realtime

key.description: the SHA-256 of the key the door handed whoever opened it, which every change to the session carries
